children: Dara Khosrowshahi, a director and Chief Executive Officer, purchased 141,000 shares of common stock at a weighted average price of $70.9642 per share. The total purchase amount reported was $10,005,952. Following the transaction, Khosrowshahi directly owns 1,367,100 shares of common stock. The filing notes the shares were bought in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $70.73 to $71.18 and that 298 shares acquired May 20, 2026, were under Uber’s 2019 Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
